# Module `lune_ui_core::window`

[API reference](../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core`](index.md)

Helpers for a borderless glass window: edge resizing, title-bar double click and Windows 11
style caption buttons. The caller owns the event loop and calls these from it. The winit side
(window attributes, edge → resize direction) is in the `lune-ui-winit` crate.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/window.rs:1`

## Functions

<a id="fn.caption_buttons"></a>
### Function `caption_buttons`

```rust
pub fn caption_buttons<H: Copy + PartialEq>(
    p: &mut Painter<'_, H>,
    win: Rect,
    height: f32,
    maximized: bool,
    hits: [H; 3],
)
```

Windows 11 style caption buttons (minimize, maximize or restore, close) along the top right of
`win`, each `height` tall. `hits` are the hit values for [minimize, maximize, close]. The `Ui`
form, with hover motion, semantic nodes and strings, is
[`Ui::caption_buttons`](ui.md#method.Ui.caption_buttons).

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/window.rs:90`

Which edge of a borderless window of size `w` × `h` the point `p` is on, for resizing.
